brief: Propose migrating 14 consumers from Cache API v1 to Cache API v2 by 2026-09-30. The compatibility guide is https://example.test/cache-v2. Keep v1 available until every consumer reports a successful production read.
Track support for parser 3.4.0, blocked on upstream issue #812. Do not begin implementation before #812 ships. Completion means Linux and macOS fixtures pass without the compatibility patch.
Propose reducing checkout p95 latency from 180 ms to a 120 ms budget. The first change is query batching. Mobile clients are out of scope. Roll back if the payment error rate exceeds 0.2%.

Propose enabling automated dependency update pull requests for 8 internal packages starting 2026-10-01. Allow patch releases only and cap the bot at 2 open pull requests per package. Pause it if its pull requests cause the CI failure rate to exceed 5%. Completion means every package has received and merged one valid patch-update pull request. Minor and major updates are out of scope.

Propose enabling zstd compression for CI caches in 6 repositories on 2026-10-15, with an expected 30% reduction in cache upload size. Use the reversible CI_CACHE_ZSTD flag and disable it if median build time worsens by more than 3%. Completion means each repository records 20 successful cached builds. Release jobs are out of scope.

Propose enabling one automatic retry for network-timeout failures in documentation link checks across 5 repositories starting 2026-10-20 to reduce false failures. Do not retry HTTP errors. Disable the retry if median job duration increases by more than 10%. Completion means each repository records 50 runs without masking a genuinely broken link. Security scans are out of scope.
